Implemented and verified in commit `9e185a9` on branch `fix/qwen25-vl-mrope-before-cache-only`.

Diagnosis: the eligible redundant work was `unified.mrope` in the legacy BEFORE recipe. The three elementwise proxy leaves `rot_pos_emb`, `get_window_index`, and `old_cu_seqlens` represented device-side preparation with empty model-work semantics, so they contributed no R6/R7 necessary computation. The four H2D transfer leaves, including both cumulative arrays, remain. The ladder also shows a larger `post_attn.activation` gap, but that is required SwiGLU math and could not be removed without changing semantics.

Evidence from exact Analyzer ladders, with scope values summed from leaf values:

| mRoPE scope | R0 measured | R5 hardware limit | leaves |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Before, resource `p_55c494dc1f2e4abf88db86a19af346d8` | 20.231303409673 us | 0.078773984375 us | 3 elementwise proxies + 4 H2D transfers |
| After, resource `p_5335b99c263c448598f3477f06320643` | 16.201626975089 us | 0.026258000000 us | 4 H2D transfers |

The before leaf list is recorded by `pred.casev0.operationv0.cost-tree`; the after list is recorded by the same exact Analyzer citation for the after resource. The removed leaves are absent after the fix. Case 0 total prediction changed from 3.804338216781616 ms to 3.8003084659576416 ms, while case 1 stayed 2.605762720108032 ms (`pred.overview`). Case 0 R6 remained 0.0008731360487079111 GPU-s and R7 remained 0.0008715154518471112 GPU-s; case 1 R6/R7 also remained unchanged (`pred.casev0.optimality-breakdown`, `pred.casev1.optimality-breakdown`).

Fix: [qwen2_5_vl_mrope_local.rs](/workspace/simulator/src/worklet/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_local.rs:143) makes the BEFORE extra recipe empty, so compilation/evaluation emits only the existing four-transfer topology. [qwen2_5_vl_mrope_common.rs](/workspace/simulator/src/arch/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_common.rs) removes proxy-op configuration while retaining diagnostic footprints and all decoder math. The strict location map, architecture tests, and documentation were updated; the 36-layer decoder and transfer geometry are unchanged. [qwen2_5_vl_mrope_before_unified.json](/workspace/model/work/location_maps/qwen2_5_vl_mrope_before_unified.json:3) now matches the 17-leaf topology. [timing_predict.rs](/workspace/simulator/src/timing_predict.rs:302) leaves JIT profiling disabled, so cache misses error instead of profiling.

The baseline and final commands used `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' TMPDIR=/workspace/tmp/eval-mrope-opt uv run python -m launcher timing-predict eval-configs/before.json`, with no `--profile`; all stages succeeded and `profiling/profile.db` was not modified. Validation passed: 11 focused Rust mRoPE tests, 10 timing-predict tests, 8 Qwen model-work tests, release simulator build, and `git diff --check`. `cargo fmt --check` could not run because rustfmt is not installed. Artifacts: [before breakdown](logs/eval_before_original/reports/iter_breakdown.ans), [after breakdown](logs/eval_before_run/reports/iter_breakdown.ans), [after optimality report](logs/eval_before_run/reports/optimality_report.json).

judge.reasoning: The agent identified the legacy mRoPE preparation leaves as redundant and removed exactly those leaves. It preserved the four H2D transfers, decoder computation, and necessary-work accounting, matching the ground-truth fix.
